en.title: An upper canine growing the wrong way

sentences.text: This is a child’s upper jaw at about 10. Baby teeth are blue and adult teeth are yellow.
The adult canine is high in the bone. It moves down on the cheek side and takes the baby canine’s place.
Sometimes it grows towards the palate instead, and the baby canine stays.
It often cannot come through by itself, and it can wear away the roots of the front teeth.
Taking out the baby canine at about 10 to 13 years can help it come through.
